mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_teacher_metrics ( teacher_id, metric_date, new_enrollments, revenue_cents, active_students, completed_courses_count ) VALUES ( #{teacherId}, #{metricDate}, #{newEnrollments}, #{revenueCents}, #{activeStudents}, #{completedCourses} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE new_enrollments = new_enrollments + VALUES(new_enrollments), revenue_cents = revenue_cents + VALUES(revenue_cents), active_students = GREATEST(active_students, VALUES(active_students)), completed_courses_count = completed_courses_count + VALUES(completed_courses_count), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
